# GitHub collaboration

Use the [issue forms](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/) to propose capabilities, investigate
designs, report defects, and define verification activities. Coordinate through
issues and link requirements, interface documents, notebook entries, and evidence.

The [pull request template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) supports cross-team review.
See [contributing guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for branch names and review
expectations. These templates do not configure branch protection, team
permissions, labels, or automation.
